map.title: The Campaign of Andranik Grigoryan
map.subtitle: Six years of infrastructure, charted
map.hint: WASD to march · click to travel · Space to strike · 1–3 to swap tools · ride to a keep and accept its mission
map.legend: Ride to a keep to read its chronicle. Your lantern travels with you — the land closes up behind it.

castle.name: Codedcloud Spire
castle.motto: A thousand gigabytes a day, and none of them lost

bullets: Configured observability stack handling **1 TB/day** of telemetry (logs, traces, metrics), achieving 90% service monitoring coverage and improving incident response management
Implemented infrastructure-as-code for CDN configuration, establishing a controlled change process that significantly reduced manual errors and optimised deployment workflows
Optimised CI/CD pipelines, cutting total deployment time from **30 to 12 minutes**
Automated manual operational tasks, reducing incidents and improving business processes

mission.name: Hold the Telemetry Watch
mission.brief: A terabyte a day is pouring into the Spire, and something in it is hostile. Keep the walls standing.

tools.name: OpenTelemetry
tools.note: Pings through a line of foes; shows what hides

castle.name: Codeex Citadel
castle.motto: Every stone accounted for in code

bullets: Migrated a manually configured AWS environment to **100% IaC coverage**, improving security, auditability, and operational consistency
Designed and deployed a business-critical custom DNS service handling **200M+ requests/day** across 6 regions
Drove infrastructure cost reduction of **30%** through targeted optimisation initiatives
Built observability and incident response management systems, improving service availability and SLA compliance
Achieved SOC 2 compliance and fulfilled AWS Partner Program infrastructure requirements, strengthening security posture and business credibility

mission.name: Break the Siege of the Citadel
mission.brief: Six regions, two hundred million queries a day, and an audit at the gate. The Citadel must not fall.

tools.name: Prometheus
tools.note: Pings through a line of foes; shows what hides

castle.name: Goya Hold
castle.motto: A platform raised from bare metal

bullets: Designed and implemented on-premise Kubernetes infrastructure serving as an Internal Developer Platform (IDP)
Led the project from scope definition through final delivery
Collaborated with management and supply teams to ensure smooth project delivery operations

mission.name: Raise the Platform
mission.brief: Bare metal below, developers above. Hold the Hold while the cluster comes up.

tools.name: Kubernetes
tools.note: Fast wheel, cuts through two at a time

tools.name: Helm
tools.note: One chart, a whole release radius

bullets: Deployed and maintained ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for centralised log aggregation and real-time monitoring across production services
Built and managed Azure cloud infrastructure, supporting application workloads and ensuring high availability
Designed and implemented CI/CD pipelines, improving release automation and reducing deployment friction
Administered Linux-based server environments and automated routine operational tasks using Bash and Python

mission.name: Light the First Beacon
mission.brief: The Watch has no eyes yet. Hold the gate while the logs start flowing.
